ListSql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [r].[ID]) AS [ID], [r].[Name], [r].[IntegrationId], [r].[ShortCode], CASE
    WHEN [r].[CountryID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [r].[CountryID])
END AS [CountryID], [r].[DisplayOrder], [r].[IsDeleted], [c].[Name] AS [Country], [c].[DisplayOrder] AS [CountryDisplayOrder]
FROM [ShiftIdentity].[Regions] AS [r]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Countries] AS [c] ON [r].[CountryID] = [c].[ID]
